newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid bourse officially closed after problems.
newsitem.headline: Madrid bourse officially closed after problems.

text.p: The Madrid bourse was officially closed on Friday after it was delayed due to sharp movements in prices immediately before the end.
The stock market's governing body said it had considered re-opening the market after prices moved sharply, leading them to suspect there may have been some form of false move, but decided not to.
"The strong movement in prices in the last moments of the session led us to consider the possibility to re-open the market," a spokesman from the Sociedad de Bolsas said.
The general index closed 6.10 points higher, 1.33 percent, at 465.59, while the Ibex-35 index closed 70.75 points up, 1.35 percent, at 5,327.42.
